         }
 
         // fix value to take special cases (+0/+0, +0/-0, -0/+0, -0/-0, +/-infinity) correctly
+        if (Double.isNaN(result[resultOffset])) {
+            // When both x and y are 0, atan2 should return the value based on signs
+            // atan2(0, 0) = 0, atan2(+0, -0) = pi, atan2(-0, +0) = -0, atan2(-0, -0) = -pi
+            result[resultOffset] = FastMath.atan2(y[yOffset], x[xOffset]);
+            // For derivatives: when both x and y are at origin, their derivatives become 0
+            for (int i = 1; i < getSize(); ++i) {
+                result[resultOffset + i] = 0;
+            }
+        }
 
     }
